tasks.title: Arkadaşını davet et
tasks.prompt: Doğum günü yemeği veriyorsun. Bir arkadaşına e-posta yaz: ne, ne zaman, nerede olduğunu söyle ve cevap iste.

teach.title: Samimi e-postanın dört parçası
points: Selamlama: Hi Ali, / Hello Ayşe,
Sebep: I'm writing to invite you to ...
Ayrıntılar: gün, saat, yer — üçü de olmalı
Kapanış: Let me know if you can come. / See you soon, Deniz

phrases.en: I'm writing to invite you to ...
It starts at eight.
Let me know if you can come.
Hope to see you there!

tasks.model:
Hi Ayşe,

I'm writing to invite you to my birthday dinner next Saturday. We are meeting at Meze Evi in Kadıköy at eight o'clock. There will be about ten people, mostly friends from university, so it should be a relaxed evening.

Let me know by Thursday if you can come, because I need to book the table.

Hope to see you there!

Deniz

tasks.title: Geç kalma özrü
tasks.summary: Özür dile ve yeni bir zaman öner
tasks.prompt: Bir arkadaşınla buluşacaktın ama gidemedin. Özür dileyen bir e-posta yaz: neden gelemedin ve yeni bir zaman öner.

teach.title: Özür e-postasının sırası
points: Önce özür, sonra açıklama — sırayı ters çevirmek bahane gibi durur
Kısa tut; uzun açıklama samimiyetsiz görünür
Bir çözüm öner: yeni bir gün, telafi
Suçu başkasına atma

phrases.en: I'm really sorry about yesterday.
Something came up at work.
Can we meet on Thursday instead?
It won't happen again.

tasks.model:
Hi Mert,

I'm really sorry about yesterday. My daughter got sick in the afternoon and I had to take her to the doctor, so I could not get to the café in time. I should have called you earlier instead of just sending a message.

Can we meet on Thursday evening instead? I am free after six, and coffee is on me this time.

Sorry again,
Deniz

tasks.title: Bilgi isteme
tasks.summary: Resmî e-posta: net sorular, kibar ton
tasks.prompt: Bir dil okulunun yaz kursu hakkında bilgi istiyorsun. Resmî bir e-posta yaz ve en az üç net soru sor.

teach.title: Resmî e-posta samimi olandan nasıl ayrılır
points: Dear Sir or Madam, / Dear Ms Yılmaz, ile başla — 'Hi' değil
İlk cümlede kim olduğunu ve neden yazdığını söyle
Soruları maddeler hâlinde ver; paragrafın içinde kaybolmasın
Kısaltma kullanma: 'I am' yaz, 'I'm' yazma
Yours faithfully (isim bilinmiyorsa) / Yours sincerely (biliniyorsa) ile bitir

phrases.en: I am writing to enquire about ...
I would be grateful if you could tell me ...
Could you also let me know whether ...
phrases.tr: Ayrıca ... olup olmadığını da bildirir misiniz?

phrases.en: I look forward to hearing from you.

tasks.model:
Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to enquire about the summer English courses advertised on your website. I am a Turkish student at intermediate level and I am planning to study in Manchester in July.

I would be grateful if you could tell me the following:

- How many hours per week does the intensive course include?
- What is the average class size, and are students placed by a level test?
- Do you arrange accommodation with host families, and what is the additional cost?

Could you also let me know whether places are still available for the July intake?

I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours faithfully,
Deniz Kaya

tasks.title: İş başvurusu
tasks.prompt: Bir iş ilanına başvuruyorsun. Hangi pozisyon için yazdığını, deneyimini ve neden uygun olduğunu anlat.

teach.title: Başvuru e-postasında işe yarayan şey
points: İlk cümlede hangi pozisyon olduğunu yaz; işe alan kişi günde otuz e-posta okuyor
Sıfat değil kanıt ver: 'hard working' değil, 'managed a team of four for two years'
İlandaki gereksinimlerden ikisini seç ve doğrudan onlara cevap ver
Ekini belirt: I have attached my CV.
Bir sayfayı geçme; uzun başvuru okunmuyor

phrases.en: I am writing to apply for the position of ...
I have three years of experience in ...
In my current role, I am responsible for ...
I have attached my CV for your consideration.

tasks.model:
Dear Ms Bennett,

I am writing to apply for the position of Junior Data Analyst advertised on your careers page on 12 March.

I have three years of experience in reporting and analysis at a logistics company in Istanbul. In my current role, I am responsible for the weekly delivery performance report, which I rebuilt in SQL and Power BI last year; the preparation time dropped from two days to about three hours. Your advertisement mentions stakeholder communication, and a large part of my job is explaining these figures to operations managers who do not work with data.

I have attached my CV for your consideration and would be glad to discuss my application further.

Yours sincerely,
Deniz Kaya

tasks.title: Şikâyet e-postası
tasks.prompt: Aldığın bir ürün hasarlı geldi ve müşteri hizmetleri iki haftadır cevap vermiyor. Şikâyet e-postası yaz: ne oldu, ne yaptın, ne istiyorsun.

teach.title: Sonuç alan şikâyetin kuralları
points: Öfke yerine olgu: tarih, sipariş numarası, ne olduğu
Ne yaptığını sırayla yaz — bu, konuyu ilerletmiş olduğunu gösterir
Ne istediğini açıkça söyle: iade, değişim, tazminat
Bir tarih ver: 'within seven working days'
Tehdit değil, bir sonraki adımı sakin biçimde belirt

phrases.en: I am writing to complain about ...
Despite two reminders, I have received no reply.
I would like a full refund.
I trust this can be resolved without further escalation.
phrases.tr: Konunun daha ileri götürülmeden çözüleceğine inanıyorum.

tasks.model:
Dear Customer Services,

I am writing to complain about order 48231, placed on 3 April. The coffee machine arrived on 9 April with a cracked water tank and a bent power cable, and it has never been used.

I reported the damage through your online form on the same day and attached photographs. I sent a reminder on 16 April and telephoned your helpline on 21 April, where I was told that a case had been opened. Despite this, I have received no reply and no case number.

Under the consumer regulations the item is not of satisfactory quality, and I would like a full refund of 4,750 lira, including the original delivery charge. I am happy to return the machine in its original packaging if you arrange collection.

I would be grateful for a written response within seven working days. I trust this can be resolved without further escalation.

Yours faithfully,
Deniz Kaya

tasks.title: Kötü haberi iletmek
tasks.prompt: Yönettiğin proje üç hafta gecikecek. Müşteriye e-posta yaz: durumu açıkla, sebebini söyle, yeni planı ver ve hangi önlemi aldığını belirt.

teach.title: Kötü haber e-postası
points: Haberi ilk paragrafta ver; sona saklamak güveni bitirir
Edilgen çatıya sığınma: 'mistakes were made' değil, 'we underestimated'
Sebep açıkla ama bahane üretme — ikisinin farkı, sorumluluğu kimin aldığı
Yeni tarih ver ve o tarihi neyin koruduğunu söyle
Sonraki temas noktasını belirle: 'I will update you every Friday'

phrases.en: I want to let you know as early as possible that ...
phrases.tr: Mümkün olduğunca erken bildirmek istiyorum ki ...

phrases.en: The delay is on our side.
To prevent this from happening again, we have ...
I am available for a call at your convenience.
phrases.tr: Uygun olduğunuz bir zamanda görüşmeye hazırım.

require.label: Haberi erken verdin
any: i want to let you know

tasks.model:
Dear Mr Whitfield,

I want to let you know as early as possible that the reporting module will not be ready for the 30 May launch. Our revised date is 20 June.

The delay is on our side. When we scoped the module in February we assumed your finance data would arrive in a single consistent format. In practice there are four legacy systems with different currency and date conventions, and the reconciliation logic has taken roughly three times the effort we estimated. We should have validated that assumption with a sample extract before committing to the date, and we did not.

The rest of the platform is unaffected and will go live on 30 May as planned, so your team can begin onboarding on schedule. For the interim period we will provide the existing monthly export, which covers the two reports your finance team uses most.

To prevent this from happening again, we have added a data discovery phase to the start of every workstream, and I have moved two engineers from the dashboard team onto reconciliation. I will send you a short written update every Friday until the module ships.

I am available for a call at your convenience if you would like to go through the revised plan in detail.

Kind regards,
Deniz Kaya
